text: This lesson publishes the finished report to a Power BI Service workspace Executives can actually reach, from a browser or the mobile app, with no desktop installation needed.

The scheduled refresh's timing is the real lesson here: the warehouse load runs first, Chapter 3's Python validation runs second, and only after both finish does the Power BI refresh pull in that night's numbers — already known to have passed every check.

Power BI Service is cloud-hosted, but the warehouse lives on an on-premises SQL Server. An On-premises Data Gateway is the real bridge that makes a scheduled refresh against that warehouse possible at all.
Finishing this lesson completes the Power BI deliverable for Executives — not the whole capstone. Next chapter builds the Board's Tableau deck, independently, on the exact same warehouse.
